summary_en: Kamgras 1 (Bain Capital vehicle) revised tender offer for Kakaku.com: offer price raised from ¥3,000 to ¥3,450 per share; offer period extended to 10 business days from 31 July 2026, closing 17 August 2026; both price and timeline changes follow competing proposal at ¥3,384 from Bain and LINE Yahoo on 1 July; revised price characterized as highest economically feasible level vs. LINE Yahoo consortium proposal.
title_en: Notice of Change in Terms of Tender Offer for Shares, etc. of Kakaku.com, Inc. (Securities Code: 2371) by Kamgras 1 Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: Kamgras 1 Co., Ltd. (a limited partnership controlled by Bain Capital Private Equity LP, formed 1 June 2026) initiated a tender offer for Kakaku.com Inc. on 13 May 2026 at an original price of ¥3,000 per share. On 1 July 2026, Bain Capital and LINE Yahoo Co., Ltd. submitted a competing binding proposal for ¥3,384 per share (with a higher ¥3,500 contingent on KDDI's agreement not to tender). On 31 July 2026, Kamgras 1 revised the tender offer terms: the offer price was raised to ¥3,450 per share, and the offer period was extended from 3 August 2026 to 17 August 2026 (10 business days from the revision date). The offeror characterized ¥3,450 as the highest economically feasible price, exceeding the ¥3,384 floor from the LINE Yahoo–Bain proposal and viewing its own revised offer as superior in certainty and timing of execution.
